summary_en: ARE Holdings executed a block buyback of 2.2 million shares (2.55% of outstanding shares) at 3,070 yen per share on November 5, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3, for a total of 6,754 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On November 5, 2026, ARE Holdings executed a block purchase of treasury stock through the Tokyo Stock Exchange's off-hours trading system (ToSTNeT-3). The company acquired 2.2 million shares, representing 2.55% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), at a fixed price of 3,070 yen per share, the closing price on November 4, 2026. The total purchase amount was 6,754 million yen. This execution was based on a board resolution announced on November 4, 2026, under the framework of the company's articles of incorporation pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act. The block purchase was conducted as a single transaction on the morning of November 5, 2026, and the company announced the results after market close. The company noted that it had received notification from certain shareholders of their intention to sell their holdings, consistent with the sale orders used to execute this purchase.
